sql.query: SELECT gc.id,gc.workflowId,gc.contractName,gc.renderedHtml,gc.contractingEntitySnapshot,gc.contractPartiesSnapshot,(SELECT t.tenantName FROM tbl_tenants t WHERE t.id=gc.tenantId LIMIT 1) tenantName,gc.status,gc.templateVersionNumber,gc.contractVersionNumber,gc.rowVersion,gc.draftModifiedDate,gc.draftModifiedByUserId,COALESCE(draftUser.displayName,'Unknown user') draftModifiedByUserName,gc.createdDate,gc.issuedDate,gc.pdfFileName,gc.pdfSha256,gc.pdfGeneratedDate,w.workflowName,ct.templateName,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') generatedBy,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles capUtr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions capRp ON capRp.roleId=capUtr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions capP ON capP.id=capRp.permissionId AND capP.permissionCode='agreements.drafts.edit' AND capP.isActive=1 WHERE capUtr.userId=:userId AND capUtr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND capUtr.isActive=1) canEditDraft,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles capUtr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions capRp ON capRp.roleId=capUtr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions capP ON capP.id=capRp.permissionId AND capP.permissionCode='agreements.issue' AND capP.isActive=1 WHERE capUtr.userId=:userId AND capUtr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND capUtr.isActive=1) canIssue,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles capUtr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions capRp ON capRp.roleId=capUtr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions capP ON capP.id=capRp.permissionId AND capP.permissionCode='agreements.revise' AND capP.isActive=1 WHERE capUtr.userId=:userId AND capUtr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND capUtr.isActive=1) canRevise,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles capUtr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions capRp ON capRp.roleId=capUtr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions capP ON capP.id=capRp.permissionId AND capP.permissionCode='agreements.deliver' AND capP.isActive=1 WHERE capUtr.userId=:userId AND capUtr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND capUtr.isActive=1) canDeliver FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=gc.workflowId AND w.tenantId=gc.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_contract_templates ct ON ct.id=gc.templateId AND ct.tenantId=gc.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=gc.generatedByUserId LEFT JOIN tbl_users draftUser ON draftUser.id=gc.draftModifiedByUserId WHERE gc.id=:id AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status<>'archived' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
